etymologies.etymologyHTML: From up- +‎ load.

definitions.definition: (transitive, intransitive, computing) To transfer data to a computer on a network, especially to a server on the Internet.
(Canada) To transfer jurisdiction and responsibility of a government asset or service to a higher level of government. [1][2]

quote.citation: 2022, Dakota Brasier, “Mayor John Tory's pitch to have province take over Toronto highways shot down”, in CBC:
quote.text: Our government will not be uploading the DVP or Gardiner Expressway and will not be imposing any new tolls on any roads in Ontario.  [3]
